announcements.title: 🏦 Supported Payment Methods
announcements.content:
GOM provides secure deposit and withdrawal options through trusted payment partners available in each supported country and region. Processing times and available payment methods may vary depending on local financial systems and regulations.

Users can complete transactions through supported local banks, digital payment services, and other approved payment channels available in their country. All payment records and transaction confirmations are handled through secure verification processes to ensure a reliable experience for the global GOM community.
